keyset.title: Keyset
keyset.profile_help: Tagh suidheachadh iuchrach a chaidh a shàbhaladh
keyset.profile_delete_prompt: Sguab às "%s"? Chan urrainnear seo a chuir dheth.
keyset.profile_picker_tip: Tagh pròifil a chaidh a shàbhaladh
keyset.profile_new_tip: Cruthaich pròifil air a chopaigeadh o na ceanglachan làithreach
keyset.compare_hint: Tagh eadar-dhealachaidhean airson lethbhreac a dhèanamh bhon stòr a-steach don phròifil ghnìomhach. Chan urrainnear gnìomhan a tha a dhìth bhon stòr a chopaigeadh.
keyset.compare_no_differences: Tha na h-aon cheanglaichean aig na pròifilean sin.
keyset.compare_missing_source_hint: Chan eil ceangal stòr sam bith aig a’ ghnìomh seo agus chan urrainnear a chopaigeadh.
keyset.compare_changed: Pròifilean air atharrachadh. Dèan lèirmheas air na h-eadar-dhealachaidhean ùraichte mus cuir thu a-steach iarrtas.
keyset.search_syntax_tip: Cleachd #category, @mod, $key no {modifier}. Thoir luaidh air ainmean le beàrnan, mar eisimpleir @ ​​“Gnìomhachadh Bloc Cruinn”. Cuir còmhla sìoltachain le ainmean gnìomh.
keyset.keyboard_hint: Tagh gnìomh, agus an uairsin cliog air iuchair no putan na luchaige
keyset.no_bindings: Chan eil ceanglachan sam bith a' freagairt ris na criathragan sin.
keyset.capture_binding_tip: Cliog, an uairsin brùth air iuchair no putan na luchaige
keyset.virtual_key_tip: Briog gus criathradh le %s; fhad ‘s a tha thu a’ glacadh, sònraich an cuir a-steach seo
keyset.capture_prompt: A' sònrachadh %s · Bheir Escape air falbh an ceangal gu lèir
keyset.reset_all_prompt: Tillidh a h-uile ceangal gu na roghainnean bunaiteach aca.
keyset.error: Cha b' urrainn dhuinn a shàbhaladh: %s
keyset.error_generic: Cha b' urrainn dhuinn an t-atharrachadh seo a shàbhaladh. Thoir sùil air an loga is feuch ris a-rithist.
keyset.error.shared_conflict: Dh’atharraich na roghainnean ann an eisimpleir Minecraft eile. Dèan lèirmheas air na luachan ùraichte is feuch ris a-rithist.
keyset.error.shared_sync: Cha ghabh na roghainnean co-roinnte ùrachadh. Tha na ceanglaichean gnàthach agad air an cumail.
keyset.error.recovered: Chaidh ìomhaigh millte fhaighinn air ais bho chùl-taic.
keyset.error.storage: Cha b' urrainn dhuinn stòradh pròifil a leughadh no a sgrìobhadh. Thoir sùil air clàr nan geamannan.
keyset.conflict_peers: Gnìomhan eile air a' cheangal seo: %s
keyset.conflict_replace_tip: Dì-cheangail am measgachadh seo bho gach gnìomh connspaideach eile
keyset.conflict_swap_tip: Gluais an gnìomh eile dhan cheangal a bha aig a' ghnìomh seo roimhe: %s
keyset.conflict_swap_unavailable: Ri fhaighinn às deidh dhut iuchair a shònrachadh a tha an aghaidh aon ghnìomh eile
keyset.conflict_gone: Chaidh a’ chòmhstri seo fhuasgladh no atharrachadh.
keyset.conflict_changed: Ceangalaichean air an atharrachadh ann an uinneag eile. Dèan lèirmheas air a’ chòmhstri a-rithist.
keyset.undo_done: An t-atharrachadh mu dheireadh air a chur dheth
keyset.auto_profile_requires_world: Thig còmhla ri saoghal no frithealaiche gus pròifil fèin-ghluasadach a shuidheachadh
keyset.auto_profile_set_tip: Cleachd %s airson an t-saoghail no am frithealaiche seo
keyset.auto_profile_remove_tip: Thoir air falbh pròifil fèin-obrachail airson %s
keyset.auto_profile_removed: Pròifil fèin-obrachail air a thoirt air falbh airson %2$s (%1$s)
keyset.selection_empty: Tagh gnìomh air an taobh dheas
keyset.selection_hint: Brùth iuchair no putan na luchaige · Escape unbinds.
keyset.footer_hint: Atharrachaidhean a’ sàbhaladh sa bhad · Bidh Escape a’ dùnadh an deasaiche
keyset.no_bindings_for_key: Chan eil gnìomh air fhàgail air %s.
keyset.native_hint: Hotkey MaLiLib · brùth measgachadh, an uairsin leig às na h-iuchraichean aige
keyset.native_capture_prompt: Brùth measgachadh, an uairsin leig às · Escape unbinds
keyset.transfer_import_prompt: Ion-phortaich pròifilean o %s faidhle(an) JSON sa phasgan tar-chuir Keyset co-roinnte? Thèid pròifilean co-ionann a sheachnadh.
keyset.transfer_exported: Pròifil às-mhalairt dhan phasgan gluasaid Keyset co-roinnte. Gheibh togalaichean Minecraft eile cothrom air.
keyset.transfer_duplicate: Gun phròifil ùra. Tha na pròifilean sin mar-thà an làthair.
keyset.transfer_empty: Cuir faidhlichean JSON pròifil às-mhalairt anns a’ phasgan gluasaid Keyset co-roinnte an toiseach.
keyset.visibility_hint: Falaich no thoir air ais mòdan agus roinnean gun a bhith ag atharrachadh na hotkeys aca
keyset.visibility_hint_count: Earrainnean falaichte: %s. Hotkeys fhathast gnìomhach; tha còmhstri fhathast a’ toirt a-steach gnìomhan falaichte.
keyset.visibility_hide_section: Hide this section: collapse it and remove its highlights from the keyboard. Hotkeys will keep working.
keyset.visibility_hidden_notice: Section hidden: %1$s. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.visibility_explanation: Gnìomhan falaichte a’ fuireach ceangailte agus gnìomhach
keyset.visibility_show_tip: Thoir air ais an earrann seo dhan neach-deasachaidh
keyset.visibility_hide_tip: Falaich bhon neach-deasachaidh; Hotkeys fuireach gnìomhach
keyset.visibility_search_syntax_tip: Cleachd #category no @mod gus an liosta atharrachadh agus a sgrùdadh. Cuir ainmean le beàrnan ann an luachan.
keyset.profile_scope_shared: Pròifilean: air an roinn thairis air suidheachaidhean
keyset.profile_scope_detach_tip: Cleachd pròifilean fa leth airson an t-suidheachaidh seo. Thèid lethbhreac a dhèanamh de na pròifilean agad nuair a thèid an cleachdadh an toiseach; Thèid pròifilean ionadail a th’ ann mar-thà ath-nuadhachadh. Bidh pròifilean co-roinnte fhathast rim faighinn.
keyset.profile_scope_attach_tip: Ath-cheangail ri pròifilean co-roinnte gun tighinn còmhla. Tha na pròifilean fa leth agad gan cumail airson nas fhaide air adhart.
keyset.profile_scope_detached: Pròifilean fa leth air an comasachadh airson an t-suidheachaidh seo
keyset.themes_empty: Save your current colors as a theme.
keyset.themes_exported: Theme exported to %s and copied to the clipboard.
keyset.themes_import_hint: Import theme JSON from the clipboard, or place a theme file in %s.
keyset.themes_no_import: No theme JSON found in the clipboard or transfer folder.
keyset.preview_scroll_hint: Drag the bar to view the rest of the keyboard
keyset.legend_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.
keyset.keyboard_fn_hint: Fn is controlled by the keyboard hardware. It is shown for reference and cannot be bound separately.
keyset.appearance_mouse_body_hint: Color of the top and side mouse shell. Button colors follow their binding state.
keyset.bottom_hint: Select a key, then move it left or right.
keyset.bottom_fit_hint: Other key widths adjust to fit. Click the width to restore Auto.
keyset.section_hidden_tip: This section is hidden. Use + to restore it. Its hotkeys still work in game.
keyset.section_unbind_prompt: Are you sure you want to unbind all keys in "%1$s"? This will clear bindings for all %2$s actions in the current profile, including actions outside the current search. You can undo this change.
keyset.section_unbind_title: Unbind all keys in this section?
keyset.themes_copy_hint: Copy this resource-pack theme to your saved themes to edit it independently.
keyset.themes_copied: Theme copied to your saved themes.
